evidence_labels.new: reproduced or measured in /data/trebuchet-clean during this milestone
evidence_labels.inherited: reported by the supplied Trebuchet handoff; not rerun in this milestone
evidence_labels.source: verified in the current checkout but not necessarily exercised

entries.name: Indirect-branch and jump-table recovery
entries.evidence: new: full PX4 attempt widened 17 Thumb byte jump tables, but the whole artifact was invalid before execution
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Publish a bounded valid image containing one recovered real hot switch, then exercise fallback destinations.

entries.name: Symbolic references and code-address identity
entries.evidence: new: strict final gates found four distinct changed observable PC-relative addresses in the PX4 full policy
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Add a deterministic pre-layout eligibility or address-preserving placement rule; do not use a growing name exclusion list.

entries.name: Verified regions with complete fallback
entries.evidence: new: the full PX4 region failed publication; the scoped memset region published and retained an input-entry redirect
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Challenge the scoped fallback with unmatched/fault paths and add an identity publication control.

entries.name: Joint FastDyn profitability
entries.evidence: new: one mission-hot memset layout was active but measured 0.972744x median paired speedup; host b2-layout was requested for both guests but produced inactive identity artifacts
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Add a lower-cost guest condition; fix host profile consumption and activation before combined timing.

entries.name: Final-size/range-aware hot fragments
entries.evidence: new: full output grew beyond physical flash and failed final PC-relative address checks
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Implement a final emitted-size/flash-capacity budget and deterministic convergence/rejection before another split variant.

entries.name: Empirical parameter and interaction tuning
entries.evidence: new: bounded original-versus-one-function layout comparison completed; inherited: prior guest and cache sweeps are indexed by the handoff ledger
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Use fresh development inputs for the next sweep and reserve a held-out set before selecting policy.

entries.name: Callsite, target, and value profiles
entries.evidence: new: full mission TB/edge profile captured 961208042 TB executions; no bounded scalar-argument collector was evaluated
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Collect one real hot callee's bounded integer argument distribution and split train/development/held-out inputs.

entries.name: Guarded argument specialization
entries.evidence: source: no active PX4 guarded clone was produced
entries.remaining_prerequisite: A07 value observations and a real hot callee with a stable exact integer value.

entries.name: Guarded zero-value specialization
entries.evidence: no current milestone artifact
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Find an effect-safe hot zero-producing region and retain/test nonzero fallback.

entries.name: Extended hot indirect-target specialization
entries.evidence: new: current PX4 full-policy log reported zero profiled indirect callsites eligible for ICP; jump-table ICP was active but the image was invalid
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Use another supported real workload or an exercised missed indirect callsite, preserving residual dispatch.

entries.name: Machine-level scalar and loop analysis
entries.evidence: inherited: scalar specialization paths executed without established end-to-end gain; new: PX4 FOP changed six redundant loads in the invalid full image only
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Select an active missed real loop pattern that can publish in a valid image.

entries.name: Loop unrolling or rerolling
entries.evidence: no real-application candidate in this milestone
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Recover one real hot loop with testable zero-trip, remainder, wraparound, and footprint behavior.

entries.name: Register-only branch-diamond melding
entries.evidence: source contains conditional conversion mechanisms; no valid real PX4 comparison was run
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Find a supported register-only diamond executed under different real branch distributions.

entries.name: Hot-code growth and cold-time budgets
entries.evidence: new: scoped candidate added eight estimated total function bytes and lost; full candidate exceeded physical flash
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Charge final guest bytes, redirect transfers, and physical flash capacity in the selection policy.

entries.name: Cold repeated-code compaction
entries.evidence: inherited multi-site SuperCache compaction is not the required guest tail/sequence sharing experiment
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Identify exact stack-neutral repeated tails in a real firmware and compare no sharing, folding, and sequence sharing.

entries.name: Profile and origin lineage
entries.evidence: new: report retained original identities for 57 instructions and verified six synthesized control edges in memset
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Add an automated lineage check through a clone/split and measure reporting overhead separately.

entries.name: Stale-profile reuse
entries.evidence: inherited: profile reuse across MicroPython releases was tested; no new PX4 stale-profile claim
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Publish the exact inherited measurements or rerun fresh-versus-stale on two reproducible real revisions.

entries.name: Sparse-profile repair and flow consistency
entries.evidence: new profile reports flow-quality diagnostics but was not deliberately thinned or repaired
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Thin the real PX4 profile under a declared rule and evaluate downstream decision changes.

entries.name: Bootstrap without dynamic profiles
entries.evidence: candidate selection depended on the mission profile
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Define simple non-oracle heuristics and compare them against dynamic-profile choices.

entries.name: Campaign/phase-representative profiles
entries.evidence: new: one mission profile mixed boot and flight but no explicit phase ablation was performed
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Capture separate boot, steady-flight, error, and interrupt phases and evaluate a mixed policy.

entries.name: Profiling and coverage cost
entries.evidence: new: profiler gained idempotent normal-QEMU-exit flushing so real missions no longer need a guest stop PC; perturbation not timed
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Measure profiler overhead against the identical mission without collection.

entries.name: Explicit assumptions and fault preservation
entries.evidence: new: publication gates rejected address-changing full variants; scoped candidate passed mission checks but not targeted malformed/fault/watchpoint tests
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Add memset boundary/fault differential tests and an address/watchpoint challenge for the relocated body.

entries.name: Missed-optimization diagnostics
entries.evidence: new: full-policy diagnostics exposed the arbitrary legalization cap, four address-identity failures, physical flash overflow, and scopt's hardcoded steady-phase admission despite a configurable phase parameter
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Add pre-layout PC-relative rejection receipts and make scopt admission honor the requested profile phase, with regressions for both.

entries.name: Slow-input and optimization-level analysis
entries.evidence: one PX4 -O build and one mission were used
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Build supported -O0/-Os/-O2/-O3 images and classify real tail inputs without treating builds as independent applications.

entries.name: Analytical count cross-checks
entries.evidence: inherited: ESCape32 telemetry CRC and Hall-poll loop counts were independently verified on two images
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Bind the inherited raw count record into the clean exploration package or rerun it.

entries.name: Optional build metadata/recompilation
entries.evidence: new: PX4 rebuilt at the exact source revision with --emit-relocs; fresh DWARF was required for bridge ABI validation
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Compare a matched binary-only decision against the build-assisted one and account for rebuild cost.

entries.name: Offline scalability and summary reuse
entries.evidence: inherited: decoded-detail reuse reduced median Pye import from 13.26 s to 10.90 s; new: PX4 caches with 47005 and 48137 units imported and passed identity reimport validation, but scalability was not timed
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Time the large PX4 imports or bind the prior raw eight-pair record before a default claim.

entries.name: Host helper inlining
entries.evidence: source: host-inline splice/faulting/extreme modes exist; no completed PX4 artifact yet
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Complete matching PX4 cache import, find an executed missed helper, and compare disabled/current/extension.

entries.name: Translated CPU state and hot paths
entries.evidence: source: explicit state-sync, return/edge specialization, and chaining passes exist; inherited guarded-load behavior checks passed; no new valid PX4 host result yet
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Complete an active matching-cache PX4 host artifact with ordinary exits and dynamic validation.

entries.name: Tiering, warmup, persisted profiles/cache
entries.evidence: new: cold captures imported, but warm profiles appended 7280 original-guest and 7537 rewritten-guest records; intermediate fingerprint drift caused artifact_not_used; a boot-phase retry remained inactive because admission hardcodes steady
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Fix configurable-phase admission, capture the late-translation union, prove a zero-append replay, then run A-B-A state replay.

entries.name: Host memory-stall mitigation
entries.evidence: inherited: metadata prefetch and huge-page-adjacent runtime variants did not establish whole-editor improvement
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Find an exercised stall with hardware evidence and a legal isolated locality variant.

entries.name: Guarded configuration/table specialization
entries.evidence: no current real stable-table dependency/invalidation experiment
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Identify a stable real configuration read, record dependencies, and force unknown values and writes.

entries.name: Coverage-data locality/probe versioning
entries.evidence: coverage was intentionally disabled in scored PX4 runs
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Declare the actual feedback consumer contract and compare a versioned layout without changing identities/counts.

entries.name: Host huge-page mappings
entries.evidence: inherited: huge pages were tried but whole-editor timing remained inconclusive
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Verify actual code/JIT mappings and collect iTLB plus memory-use evidence on a real workload.

entries.name: Pure rejection-predicate ordering
entries.evidence: inherited checkpoint includes opt-in guard ordering changes; no new PX4 isolated result
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Publish or rerun all rejection classes with isolated paired timing and prove predicate independence.

entries.name: State synchronization diagnostic/extension
entries.evidence: source pass exists and is disabled by default; no new active PX4 artifact
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Complete cache lifecycle, enable explicitly, prove changed executed units, and compare with host inlining/chaining.

entries.name: Guarded memory-access fast path
entries.evidence: inherited: guarded load preserved watchpoint, UART output, and returned document in measured sessions; end-to-end gain unestablished
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Bind the prior implementation/result into this checkout or rerun on a supported real application with page-boundary and instrumentation tests.

entries.name: Complete incremental restoration
entries.evidence: inherited setup-step gain does not establish complete restoration or total-input improvement
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Track all translated/helper/device/DMA/harness writes and pass real A-B-A replay.

entries.name: Analysis diagnostics
entries.evidence: new diagnostics found repeated observable-address publication failures and conservative stack-alias barriers
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Emit structured rejection rows before final linking and use them to select the next valid region.

entries.name: Type-aware host diagnostics
entries.evidence: no DWARF/perf type attribution was collected; DWARF was used only for bridge ABI and EnvLayout generation
entries.remaining_prerequisite: Demonstrate a host memory cost that ordinary address-region profiling cannot resolve, then measure diagnostic overhead.
